label: Cisco Catalyst 1300 C1300-8T-E-2G
description: Cisco Catalyst 1300 C1300-8T-E-2G - 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T (data only) plus 2 x 1G RJ45/SFP combo uplinks, 20 Gbps switching capacity, 14.88 Mpps, fanless, managed L3.

fabric.note: Cisco Table 1 states 20 Gbps switching capacity and 14.88 Mpps forwarding rate for the C1300-8T-E-2G, the full-duplex aggregate of every port at line rate (8 x 1G downlinks plus 2 x 1G RJ45/SFP combo), so nothing is oversubscribed (https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/collateral/switches/catalyst-1300-series-switches/nb-06-cat1300-ser-data-sheet-cte-en.pdf).

notes: Datasheet Table 1 and the model comparison table: 8 x 10/100/1000BASE-T downlinks plus 2 x 1G RJ45/SFP combo uplinks; 20 Gbps switching capacity, 14.88 Mpps forwarding rate, 1.5 MB shared packet buffer, 512 MB flash, ARM dual-core CPU, 1 GB DDR4, 16 K MAC entries, up to 4094 VLANs, 8 LACP groups. PoE: none. The datasheet PoE table does not list this model and the model comparison table prints Data only; worst-case system power at 110 V is 10.63 W. Cooling: Fanless per the comparison table. No stacking on this SKU: the datasheet hardware-stacking list names only the 4X and MGP models, and the model comparison table prints N/A for this one. Management: Cisco Business Dashboard and mobile app, on-device web UI, CLI and SNMPv1/v2c/v3, per the comparison table; the datasheet also states dual images, a DHCP server, RIP v2, static routing and PBR. Ports live in the Gi1/0/x space the uplinks continue from, because the datasheet prints a total of 10 Ethernet ports for this model; the RJ-45 console port and the USB Type C port are both front-panel per the datasheet hardware table. Sources: https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/collateral/switches/catalyst-1300-series-switches/nb-06-cat1300-ser-data-sheet-cte-en.pdf and https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/switches/catalyst-1300-series-switches/models-comparison.html.
